title: AZ Media
desc: A wordmark that turns visibility into a visual direction

blocks.title: AZ Media
blocks.lede: A wordmark that turns visibility into a visual direction.

blocks.statement: A PR agency should probably be good at getting noticed.
body: AZ Media’s previous identity worked, but it didn’t say much. That felt like a missed opportunity for a company whose job is giving other people’s stories a distinctive voice.
Turn the A into an arrow.

The shape pushes upward while still reading immediately as part of the wordmark. A simple metaphor for visibility, momentum and moving a story forward — without bolting a separate symbol onto the side.

blocks.text: The identity doesn’t describe the service. It behaves like it.

body: A focused wordmark construction designed to hold its confidence at presentation scale and stay solid at the smallest practical application.
A sharper identity with a point of view, without falling into the corporate shorthand so many agencies default to.
